# Wash n' Fold case data

The current White Belt case is generated by `washnfold_simulation.py`.
Staging and readiness notification are separate activities as of 2026-10-22.
The simulation uses a cumulative operating clock and ends at readiness
notification; customer pickup and payment are outside the case boundary.

## Current evidence

The default experiment exports these files:

- `washnfold_representative_current_lifecycle_log.csv`
- `washnfold_event_log.csv`
- `washnfold_learner_order_summary.csv`
- `washnfold_representative_activity_summary.csv`
- `washnfold_representative_order_metrics.csv`
- `washnfold_replication_metrics.csv`
- `washnfold_replication_summary.csv`
- `washnfold_paired_scenario_comparison.csv`
- `washnfold_capacity_summary.csv`
- `washnfold_simulation_parameters.csv`
- `washnfold_representative_run.csv`

The calendar-year experiment additionally exports
`washnfold_calendar_year_metrics.csv`.
The book resource build derives the worked excerpts, worksheets, readouts,
and their PDF/XLSX/HTML versions from this current evidence.

## Historical exports

Other tracked CSVs in this directory are retained outputs of earlier model
versions, not inputs to the current White Belt build or curated downloads.
These include the `batch_*`, `pull_*`, `5pm_*`, batch-size, sensitivity,
resource-utilization, `simulation_runs`, and paired-policy files.
Some include the former combined `Stage and notify` activity or payment and
delivery outside the current boundary. Do not mix them with the current case.
They have not been rewritten to imply that the earlier model recorded the
new separate activities.
